Tosafot on Bava Batra 94a:11:1.hebrew: סאה שיש בה רובע ימעט - פי' ר"ש: ימעט ואח"כ יזרענו. א"נ, אם נזרעו ולא נשרשו עדיין — ימעט, אבל אם נשרשו — אין להם תקנה, שכבר נשרשו ונאסרו בהשרשה. ואין נראה, דלשון "ימעט" משמע שכבר נשרשו, ור' יוסי נמי דקאמר "יבור" משום דמיחזי כמקיים כלאים, וקודם שנזרעו לא מיחזי כמקיים כלאים. ועוד, דבפרק קמא דמ"ק (דף ו. ושם) מייתי לה בהדיא על זרעים המחוברים. אלא דנראה דמיירי הכא במחוברים לקרקע. ומה שפירש דאם נשרשו אין להם תקנה — אגב חורפיה לא עיין, דלא אמר הכי פרק כל שעה (פסחים דף כה.) אלא גבי כלאי הכרם; אבל כלאי זרעים מותרין הן באכילה ובהנאה, כדמשמע פרק כל הבשר (חולין דף קטו.) דפריך: "אלא מעתה כלאי זרעים ליתסרו, דהא כל שתיעבתי לך הוא", ומשני: "מה בהמתך היוצא ממנה מותר, אף שדך כן". ואלישנא דקנסא פריך, דקתני "ימעט", ולא קנסינן פחות מרובע אטו רובע. אבל אלישנא דדינא לא מצי פריך, דלא דמי, דהתם משום דטפי מרובע לא מחיל כו', כדפירש ר"ש גופיה, דה"מ לשנויי הכי. ומיהו יש ליישב דפריך נמי אלישנא דדינא שפיר, דכל שדרך בני אדם להסיר כלאים — הוי, אם לא הסירם. ולכך, הואיל ודרך בני אדם כשבאין לנפות מנפין הכל, בכלאים נמי ליהוי כלאים עד שיסיר הכל. מכל מקום ללישנא דקנסא מיושב טפי, והוי מצי לשנויי דסבר כר' יוסי דאמר "יבור", אלא רוצה להעמיד כדברי הכל:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 94a:11:1.english: "A se'ah that has a quarter [kav of another kind] in it, he must reduce [it]" - Rashbam explained: he must reduce it, and afterward sow it. Alternatively, if they were [already] sown but have not yet taken root, he must reduce it; but if they have taken root, there is no remedy for them, since they have already taken root and become forbidden through taking root. But this does not seem right, for the term "he must reduce" implies that they have already taken root; and also R. Yose, who says "he must pick out," [says so] because it looks like he is maintaining kilayim, whereas before they are sown it does not look like he is maintaining kilayim. Furthermore, in the first chapter of Moed Katan (6a, and there) it cites this explicitly regarding seeds that are attached [to the ground]. Rather, it appears that here too [the Gemara] is speaking of seeds attached to the ground. And as for what [Rashbam] explained, that if they have taken root there is no remedy for them — in his sharpness he did not examine [the matter carefully], for [the Gemara] did not say this in Pesachim chapter Kol Sha'ah (25a) except regarding kilayim of the vineyard; but kilayim of seeds are permitted for eating and for benefit, as is implied in chapter Kol HaBasar (Chullin 115a), where [the Gemara] asks: "If so, should kilayim of seeds be forbidden, since it is 'everything that I have made abominable to you'?" And it answers: "Just as what issues from your animal is permitted, so too [what issues from] your field." And [the Gemara] asks on the version of "penalty," since [the baraita] teaches "he must reduce," and we do not penalize [a mixture of] less than a quarter on account of [a mixture of] a quarter. But on the version of "law" it cannot ask, because it is not comparable, since there [the reason] is that more than a quarter he does not forgo, etc., as Rashbam himself explained, for [the Gemara] could have answered thus. Nevertheless, it is possible to resolve that [the Gemara] properly asks on the version of "law" as well: anything that it is people's way to remove from kilayim — it counts [as kilayim] if one did not remove it. Therefore, since it is people's way, when they come to sift, to sift out everything, so too with kilayim it should count as kilayim until he removes everything. In any case, according to the version of "penalty," it is resolved better; and [the Gemara] could have answered that [the baraita] holds like R. Yose, who says "he must pick out," but [the Gemara] wants to establish it in accordance with everyone.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 94a:1:1.hebrew: נותן לו דמי חטין - פי' ריב"ם: דהיינו כר"ש, דאמר (ב"ק צח:) דבר הגורם לממון כממון דמי, דמחייב בגזל חמץ ועבר עליו הפסח [ובא אחר ושרפו]. ולר"י נראה דאתי אפי' כרבנן; דהתם ודאי לאו כממון דמי, שאינו שוה לשום אדם כלום, אלא לגזילה ליפטר בו. אבל הכא הוי כאילו גזל חטין עצמן, שהוא מוכר צרורות לכל אדם כמו חטין. ולא דמי לשורף שטרותיו של חבירו, דהתם ניירא בעלמא הוא דקלא ליה, ולא את החוב:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 94a:1:1.english: He gives him the value of wheat - Rivam explained: This is [in accordance with] Rabbi Shimon, who said (Bava Kamma 98b) that something that causes [a loss of] money is considered like money, for he is liable for robbing chametz over which Passover has passed [and another came and burned it]. But it appears to Rabbi Yitzchak that it works even according to the Rabbis; for there, [in the case of chametz,] it is certainly not considered like money, since it is worth nothing to anyone, except to fulfill the robbery [obligation] and thereby be exempt. But here, it is as if he robbed the wheat itself, since he [the robber] sells pebbles to everyone as [if they were] wheat. And it is not comparable to one who burns another's promissory notes, for there he only burned the paper, and not the debt.
